selection: First two ready histories in frozen v09 delivery order, first prefix only. No substitution after scores or tokenizer outcomes.

item_design.positive: One atomic statement directly supported by supplied source.
item_design.negative: One plausible authored semantic near-miss derived from the positive, changing one role, scope, modality or temporal claim that the source does not support. Prefer an explicit contradiction to merely unstated detail.
item_design.labels: Expected Yes/No are unversioned model-assisted source judgments, separately reviewed before scoring; not human gold.
item_design.exposure: Designer sees only this protocol and two first-prefix source requests; reviewer sees the same plus designed items, never model scores. Scorer input excludes labels and rationales.
item_design.retention: Preserve original design, review and all exclusions/changes; no score-based changes.

analysis.decision: log P(Yes)-log P(No) > 0 means Yes, < 0 means No, exactly 0 abstains.
report: Every per-item score in each model/order
Raw probability mass on Yes and No
Within-model label-order sign flips and log-odds change
Agreement with the four authored expected labels for each condition, counts only
analysis.no_selection: Do not choose a better condition, average orders, calibrate thresholds, retune prompts, or drop failed/misclassified items.
analysis.scope: Controlled challenge diagnostic with two histories and balanced authored contrasts. Not naturally sampled candidate accuracy, calibration, causal size scaling, end-to-end QA, heldout performance, or evidence of algorithmic novelty.
